post.summary: Create an account from an invitation link
post.description:
The invitee chooses the address and the display name; the role and the tenant come
from the link. The account starts without a second factor. `mfa_setup` carries what
the next step needs, both valid fifteen minutes: a TOTP secret and its QR code for
`/mfa/verify-setup`, and a setup token that `/passkey/setup/*` accepts as well.

401.description: Wrong code. Setup token invalid, expired, or issued to another account.

400.description: The account already has a second factor.

post.summary: Enable TOTP at activation, and sign in
post.description: A first code confirms the secret returned by `/activate`.

401.description: Setup token invalid, expired, or issued to another account.

400.description: The account already has a second factor.

post.summary: Start registering a passkey at activation

403.description: Account disabled.

400.description: The account already has a second factor. Or a credential that fails.

post.summary: Register the activation passkey, and sign in

403.description: Account disabled, or protected by a passkey only.

post.summary: Sign in with email and password
post.description:
Opens the session when the account has no second factor. With TOTP enabled, returns
an `mfa_token` instead, to finish with `/mfa/verify`. An account protected by a
passkey only is refused with `passkey_only` set: it signs in with `/passkey/login/*`.

404.description: Account deleted since the password step.

403.description: Account disabled since the password step.

401.description: Wrong code, or an MFA token invalid, expired or spent.

post.summary: Finish a sign-in with the authenticator-app code
post.description: The `mfa_token` from `/login` works once, within ten minutes.

post.summary: Start a passwordless sign-in
post.description:
The options allow any passkey registered for this site: the one the user picks
identifies the account.

404.description: Unknown passkey, or a disabled account.

401.description: Challenge invalid or expired, or a signature that fails.

post.summary: Finish a passwordless sign-in

403.description: Session not confirmed: `step_up_required` is set.

post.summary: Start adding a passkey
post.description:
Asks an account that already has a second factor for a confirmed session; an
account with none enrols its first freely. The options leave out the passkeys
already registered, and ask for one that serves passwordless sign-in.

403.description: Challenge invalid, expired, or issued to another account. Or: Session not confirmed: `step_up_required` is set.

post.summary: Finish adding a passkey
post.description: Guarded like `/passkey/register/begin`.

get.summary: List the account's passkeys

post.summary: Finish a password change confirmed by passkey
post.description: Ends every session, this one included.

403.description: Account disabled.

post.summary: Start a password reset confirmed by passkey

403.description: Account disabled.

post.summary: Finish a password reset confirmed by passkey
post.description: Consumes the link and ends every session.

replaces the caller's, which is not confirmed; the previous address is told by

get.summary: Get the signed-in account

401.description: Refresh token missing, expired or revoked.

post.summary: Get a new access token
post.description:
Authenticated by the refresh token. The new access token is never confirmed:
only presenting a second factor confirms a session.

401.description: Refresh token missing, expired or revoked.

post.summary: Sign out
post.description:
Authenticated by the refresh token, which is revoked with every access token issued
from it.

403.description: Session not confirmed: `step_up_required` is set.

post.summary: Hand the session over to another device
post.description:
Asks an account that has a second factor for a confirmed session. Returns a
single-use token, valid five minutes, that `/session-transfer/validate` exchanges
for a session on the other device, confirmed until the same time as this one.
Signing out of this session ends the token with it.

403.description: Account disabled.

401.description: Token invalid, expired or already used.

post.summary: Open a session from a transfer token
post.description:
The session inherits what is left of the confirmation of the one that handed it
over: the receiving device has no second factor of its own to confirm with yet.

403.description: Wrong password or code. Or no TOTP on the account: `passkey_required` is set when it has a passkey, `second_factor_required` when it has no second factor at all.

post.summary: Confirm identity with the password and the TOTP code
post.description:
Returns an access token that replaces the caller's and opens the routes asking
for a confirmed session, for ten minutes. A confirmation always attests a second
factor: an account without TOTP confirms with its passkey through
`/step-up/passkey/*`, and an account with neither cannot confirm.

post.summary: Start confirming identity with a passkey

403.description: Challenge invalid, expired or issued to another account, or a signature that fails.

post.summary: Finish confirming identity with a passkey
post.description: Returns the same confirmed access token as `/step-up/password`.

403.description: Session not confirmed: `step_up_required` is set.

post.summary: Start enabling TOTP, or moving it to another device
post.description:
Asks an account that already has a second factor for a confirmed session. Nothing
is stored yet: the secret travels in `enrolment_token` until `/mfa/setup/confirm`
checks a first code, and the TOTP in use keeps working until then.

403.description: Wrong code. Or: Session not confirmed: `step_up_required` is set.

400.description: Enrolment token invalid, expired or another account’s.

post.summary: Store the secret of an enrolment once its first code is checked
post.description:
Guarded like `/mfa/setup`. Enables TOTP, or replaces the secret of an account that
already had it. A wrong code can be tried again with the same `enrolment_token`.

403.description: Session not confirmed: `step_up_required` is set.
